Dog lunges at girls in Mumbai elevator; CCTV footage surfaces

CCTV footage has emerged showing a dog lunging at three girls inside an elevator in a Mumbai residential society. The incident, which lasted for approximately 60 seconds, has drawn public attention. The dog was reportedly muzzled at the time of the incident.
